name: bg3coop
description: Co-op Baldur's Gate 3 with an AI agent: the agent plays one party member next to you through Script Extender, on the same Windows PC.

interface.shortDescription: Play Baldur's Gate 3 together with your agent
interface.longDescription: Your agent takes over one party member in Baldur's Gate 3 and plays next to you: it follows, talks, fights on its turn and answers you through an in-game chat panel. Needs Windows, the game on Steam, Script Extender and uv; the game and Codex run on the same PC.
defaultPrompt: Start playing BG3 with me: you control Shadowheart.
Check that BG3 Co-op is connected to the game.
